description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `build-failed.json` is refused by `build/build-failed`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `buildCode`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `install`, a case that fired another check; with `rule` set to `library-absent`, a case that fired another rule.
